prompts.map: Generate an original bespoke stellar texture for Ross 248 / HH And / GJ905, a cool M dwarf. Flat seamless equirectangular longitude-latitude intensity map, exactly 2:1 landscape, filling the entire image edge to edge; grayscale luminous gas only. Research-selected spectroscopic Teff3142±51K and radius0.158±0.005 solar radii (Schweitzer2019); alternative empirical2930K0.189Rsun exists, so no calibrated colour claim. Cool partly ionized hydrogen/helium molecular photospheric gas, invented fine irregular cellular convection and sparse subtle dark magnetic patch groups, one broad broken diagonal patch group in longitude, no measured spot registration. All morphology is imagined. Grayscale intensity appropriate for a renderer that supplies approximate tint. No observed Sun texture or another body's imagery reuse. No sphere, shadows, horizon, text, field lines, solid rock, continents, oceans, volcanoes or ground. Modest contrast, irregular small gas cells, no giant solar flares. Seam-friendly left/right boundary, no directional illumination. Independent scientific concept art.
prompts.sky: Create independent 16:9 landscape conceptual near-photosphere observer image for Ross248/HHAnd/GJ905. No solid ground: free hypothetical camera at twice stellar radius from centre, facing the whole gas star against black space. Radius0.158Rsun, Teff3142K spectroscopic scenario; alternative2930K0.189Rsun disclosed elsewhere. At2R, geometric angular diameter60degrees. Nominal rectilinear horizontal FOV120degrees: circular visible photospheric bright core should occupy exactly ONE THIRD total image width, centered, approximately557pixels in1672-wide image, not fill frame. Black space all around with tiny sparse very dim background stars. Warm pale cream/peach luminous disk with subdued rust limb, artistic exposure and molecular spectral transfer, no calibrated colour claim, not bright pure red. Invented fine cool gas convection and sparse subtle patch groups, softly limb-darkened spherical photosphere, minimal halo. Entire star fully visible, no horizon/ground/planets/companions/text/labels/grid/fieldlines. No observed Sun or other body skin reuse. No giant flare. Hydrogen/helium partly ionized molecular gas, conceptual unsustainable observer position. Keep surrounding space black; keep bright core width at one third image width.
